ambient: stratification of P^5 by rank M(u)

expected.rank_5: complement of D; ker=<u>; no second common direction
expected.rank_4: smooth big cell of D birational to pointed Fano incidence
expected.rank_<=3: boundary; ker dim >=3; may contain unions of lines or singular loci

audit.note: Random sampling at good primes is dominated by rank 5; rank 4 is the positive-dimensional Fano image. Rank <=3 was rare/absent in the recorded samples and is retained as a residual boundary stratum.
